stories.title: Russian missiles hit three Kyiv bridges
sentences: Overnight Russian missile and drone barrages struck three bridges across the Dnipro River in Kyiv, killing at least nine people across Ukraine and injuring 28 others.
Mayor Vitali Klitschko closed damaged river crossings to private traffic while parts of the capital lost power, heat, and water.

stories.title: Cyclone Akvan slams eastern India coast
sentences: Severe Cyclonic Storm Akvan made landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha around 8 am with sustained winds of 70 to 90 km/h.
Authorities evacuated more than 300,000 residents into 9,341 shelters and deployed 423 rescue teams across vulnerable coastal districts.

stories.title: AI stock sell-off sinks Asian markets
sentences: Technology and chipmaking shares tumbled across Asia as investors pulled back from high-valuation artificial intelligence stocks.
Taiwan's benchmark index fell 5.6%, South Korea's KOSPI dropped 5.3%, and Japan's Nikkei 225 lost 4.8%.

stories.title: UK and EU seal Brussels reset summit deal
sentences: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham and European Union leaders Ursula von der Leyen and António Costa signed a joint summit pact in Brussels.
The agreement expands cooperation on maritime defense, hybrid threat intelligence, irregular migration, and youth educational exchanges.

stories.title: COP31 stalls on final day over fossil fuels
sentences: Climate negotiations at COP31 in Antalya entered their scheduled final day without consensus after oil-producing nations opposed explicit fossil fuel phase-out wording.
Delegations remained divided over transition timelines and climate finance commitments for developing economies.

stories.title: Russian missile crashes in southern Poland
sentences: A Russian cruise missile crashed in southeastern Poland while thousands of European troops conducted military exercises in the region.
Polish officials condemned the incident as an intentional provocation and placed regional air defenses on heightened alert.

stories.title: Iraqi forces enter Jurf al-Sakhar stronghold
sentences: Iraqi army units and federal police deployed armored vehicles into Jurf al-Sakhar southwest of Baghdad under a security compromise with Kataib Hezbollah.
Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi established a joint command to restore state authority and halt illicit pipeline oil smuggling.

stories.title: Workers and students strike across Europe
sentences: Labor unions and university students staged coordinated strikes and street marches across Italy and Croatia over rising living costs and public budget priorities.
Protesters demanded higher wages and stronger housing and education funding instead of increased military spending.

stories.title: Japan headline inflation rises to 2.3%
sentences: Government data showed Japan's headline consumer inflation accelerated to 2.3% following the expiration of household energy subsidies and higher fuel costs.
Core inflation ticked up to 2.2%, keeping pressure on the Bank of Japan ahead of next month's rate decision.

stories.title: Kenya starts drilling first Turkana oil well
sentences: Kenya switched on drilling operations for its first commercial oil well in Turkana's South Lokichar basin.
The $6 billion energy project aims to deliver first crude production early next month.

stories.title: El Salvador's Bukele files for third term
sentences: Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele formally registered his candidacy to seek a third presidential term.
The filing came as his administration simultaneously expanded overseas security deployments to combat gang violence in Haiti.

stories.title: Second federal judge blocks Trump arch plan
sentences: A second U.S. federal judge issued an order halting President Donald Trump's proposed triumphal arch monument in Washington.
The court ruled that legal challenges against the project's approval process are likely to succeed.

stories.title: Saudi coalition intercepts drones over Riyadh
sentences: Saudi air defenses intercepted five Houthi drones and one ballistic missile aimed toward Riyadh and southern border facilities.
The Saudi-led coalition responded with airstrikes targeting Houthi missile and smuggling sites in Sanaa and Hodeidah.

stories.title: ATP backs plan to lift player pay past $350m
sentences: The Association of Tennis Professionals approved a global tour reform plan in Turin aimed at lifting total player compensation past $350 million.
The package expands revenue sharing and minimum earnings guarantees for lower-ranked players competing across international circuits.

stories.title: SpaceX Dragon undocks from space station
sentences: A SpaceX Dragon cargo spacecraft undocked from the International Space Station carrying scientific experiments and research samples back to Earth.
NASA flight controllers confirmed a clean separation as the capsule began its return trajectory.

stories.title: NASA finds clues to ancient ice past Neptune
sentences: Planetary scientists at NASA reported new spectroscopic evidence of ancient subsurface ice reservoirs on distant objects orbiting beyond Neptune.
The findings shed light on how water and volatile compounds survived in the outer solar system.
